name: 45409 · Dayton, OH
findings: ZIP 45409 (Dayton) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45409 (Dayton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45409 (Dayton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
